entities.name: Durrës-Vlorë railway
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Durrës-Vlorë railway is a now mostly disused railway line connecting the cities of Durrës and Vlorë in western Albania. Vlorë station is the southernmost point on the Albanian rail system.
